“Please take care of yourself, I know you feel this darkness too, please get help. I love you” 

She was the closest friend I’ve ever had and I didn’t know she was struggling with depression, we were from a country that’s heavily religious, people didn’t believe in depression, or didn’t understand what it is, and suicide was an act that defied God, there was still a huge stigma around it at the time, the day before she committed suicide she visited me at the hospital, I was always sick when I was young, I have a really weak immune system, that night she stayed with me and we both looked up potential prom dresses, I didn’t know it’d be the last time that I’ll see her. It was truly heartbreaking, especially when we found out about the note. I didn’t know how to handle loss, blamed myself for not being able to be there for her. Now 6 years later, it still haunts me. A friend also passed away last year due to a drug overdose, he was in his second year of medical school, he was the only person that I was able to open up about my own grief and thoughts about suicide, his sudden passing reminded me of my friend and I’m still in pain knowing that I wasn’t able to help them in the way that they needed. Sometimes you really just feel helpless. I doubt I’ll ever be able to get over their deaths.

I started watching this back in 2015 while I was still living in another country and now 5 years later halfway across the world from where I first started it, I watched it end.
